title: Section 517.17(D) – Add a new Informational Note at the end of Section 517.17(D) to read as follows:
officialText:
Informational Note: Where manufacturer’s instructions are not available for existing equipment with ground fault
protection, a qualified person may perform testing and calibration to determine the tripping ground fault current and
time delay setting for such equipment.
